C0.quote: we investigate their information aggregation properties in general information
C0.note: Runoff voting as an aggregation procedure, with equilibrium analysis.

C1.quote: we show that, indeed, runoff voting can lead to full information equivalence
C1.note: Main results are existence of equilibria in which the correct alternative is elected with probability tending to 1. The correct-alternative objective is a performance criterion, hence WD as a secondary type.
